intended_use: Prototype/test role-to-skill matching; not a verified Malaysian workforce dataset.

matching_guidance.suggested_method: Compare normalized candidate skills with the role-family skill list. Treat pct_of_role as evidence/prevalence, not a mandatory requirement.
matching_guidance.simple_unweighted_score: matched skill count / number of skills considered * 100
matching_guidance.optional_weighted_score: sum of pct_of_role for matched skills / sum of pct_of_role for all skills considered * 100
matching_guidance.caution: Score is a prototype overlap indicator, not probability of employment or a calibrated fit probability.

source.citation: Qarera (2026). The Most In-Demand Job Skills of 2026: Skill-Demand Frequencies from 360,336 Job Postings. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21204423
source.geography_note: Country and compensation fields were too sparse to report; do not label these values as Malaysia-specific.
source.measurement_note: Percentages are shares of postings that mention a skill, not shares of hires, number of openings, or proof that a skill is mandatory. Role families are grouped from titles by keyword.
